Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks\*, precious metals and commodities\* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7\. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission 

As a Senior Product Designer on Bitpanda’s Web3 team, you will architect the user experiences that power our next-generation crypto ecosystem, from asset-backed loans in the Bitpanda app to tokenised structured products in the Vision Wallet. You will transform complex, data-heavy financial workflows into seamless interfaces, navigating the unique challenges of a fast-moving, highly regulated space. Partnering tightly with engineering, product, and compliance teams, your designs will directly drive customer engagement, retention, and trust. You'll shape Bitpanda's newest business lines, using AI to go from idea to working prototypes in hours and to testing them with real customers within days.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop end-to-end trading, investment, and Web3 interfaces across both mobile and web platforms
  • Simplify highly complex financial products (such as tokenized financial derivatives) into intuitive, low-friction user experiences
  • Conduct comprehensive user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis to optimize funnel conversion, engagement, and drop-off rates
  • Apply and continuously contribute to scalable design systems, ensuring consistency and performance across data-heavy interfaces
  • Use AI to prototype, test and ship faster: build working, coded prototypes in hours, test them with customers within days, and keep our design system ready for engineers' AI coding tools to build from

Who you are

  • Proven knowledge and experience in Product, UX, and UI Design, with a mandatory strong background in Crypto, Web3, or complex fintech products
  • Expert in Figma and interaction design, and AI-native in how you work: you already use AI tools to build coded prototypes and test ideas fast. 
  • Experience simplifying complex financial concepts and workflows into accessible, user-centric designs
  • Practical knowledge of working within regulated, fast-moving environments while maintaining high design delivery velocity
  • A strong data-informed mindset with experience in continuous optimization based on user metrics, coupled with deep customer empathy



\*\* This position is available remotely in one of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Your mission:

As an AML & KYC Operations Associate at Bitpanda, your mission is to actively contribute to the mitigation of money laundering and terrorist financing risks. You will ensure compliance with applicable regulations in the anti-financial crime field, demonstrating a strong commitment to preventing financial crimes perpetrated within the cryptocurrency environment. You possess a robust problem-solving and customer-oriented mindset.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Perform day-to-day reviews for Source of Funds (SoF) and/or Source of Wealth (SoW), primarily focusing on fiat transactions and low-risk customers. You will diligently oversee customers’ financial activities and identify any potential red flags on users’ accounts.
  • Analyze retail users’ financial data and their provided explanations. You will directly interact with customers to request any necessary additional documents.
  • Conduct regular transaction monitoring reviews to assess if a follow-up PoF/PoW is required, always balancing the overall customer experience with strict adherence to regulatory requirements.
  • Perform PEP, RCA and SIP screening reviews by assessing potential matches on politically exposed persons, their relatives and close associates, and special interest persons.

 

Who you are: 

  • Education: University degree in Economics, Finance, or Law.
  • Skills: Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge: Demonstrated interest in AML regulation (e.g., the AML Directives, the FM-GwG, the ESAs AML/CFT Guidelines) with a comprehensive understanding of different financial crime patterns and the broader AML/CFT landscape.
  • Industry Interest: A keen interest in the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency industry.

 

Please Note: This is an evening shift position (from 3:30 PM until midnight) for either a Tuesday to Saturday or Sunday to Thursday schedule.

At Bitpanda, we know that amazing customer service builds trust and lasting connections. As a Customer Support Associate, you’ll be the go-to person our users turn to — answering questions, solving problems, and making sure they always feel supported.

This role is the perfect way to kickstart your career in fintech if you’re fresh out of uni or just starting your journey. You’ll get hands-on experience in a fast-moving, international environment, learn directly from an experienced team, and grow your skills from day one.

Every conversation you have will help shape how people experience Bitpanda — and help you grow into the next stage of your career. 🚀

Your mission

As a Business Intelligence Analyst at Bitpanda, you’ll foster data driven decision-making by helping product, engineering, operations, finance and so many more teams collect, analyse and understand key metrics that drive growth that impacts millions of end users globally.

What you’ll do

  • Engage and collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations to identify reporting needs and potential improvements.
  • Enable analysts across the whole organisation and streamline dashboard creation.
  • Contribute to the ongoing design of our self service BI visualisation platform and core data model to support advanced analytics and business intelligence.
  • Unify business intelligence, data engineering and business stakeholders to build out data sets and models relevant to their core businesses.
  • Ensure high data quality of the core data layer with dbt models with SQL.

Who you are

  • Experience with BI Tools (Metabase, Tableau or similar), SQL, Git, dbt and Python is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work, learn and grow across teams and functions.
  • Solid experience with data-modelling (dimensional modelling, OBT or star/snowflake schemas), data quality frameworks and data visualisation tools.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional business intelligence experience or analytics engineering or data analyst with a passion for Crypto and FinTech.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business informatics, applied mathematics and statistics or similar is preferred and Master’s degree is a nice to have.

Your Mission 

As the Business Operations Specialist, you will be the operational engine behind Bitpanda's rapidly growing Securities & Commodities business line. You will ensure daily business  operations run flawlessly, manage critical external partnerships, and drive the seamless launch of major new investment products. Operating within a fast-paced, startup-like environment, your work will directly impact product launches, customer experience, and company revenue.

 

What you'll do

  • Run operational processes end-to-end, monitoring recurring tasks like instrument listings/delistings, data and venue usage reporting, partner billing, and operational follow-ups on reconciliations.
  • Manage operational partners and vendors hands-on, acting as the day-to-day contact for SLAs, incidents, invoices, and service reviews.
  • Deliver projects and launches by planning cross-team initiatives and owning launch readiness, including operational processes, Customer Support enablement, Compliance and Legal sign-offs and go-live checklists. Act as project manager for larger launches when needed.
  • Improve and automate processes by building runbooks, removing manual steps, and utilizing tooling or AI to reduce errors.
  • Create operational transparency by tracking data on volumes, incidents, and partner performance to flag trends before they become critical issues.

 

Who you are

  • You have 3+ years of experience in business operations or operational project management in financial services, for example at a broker, bank, fintech or exchange. Consulting counts if it was hands-on delivery.
  • You have a proven track record of delivering cross-functional projects end-to-end, including managing milestones, risks, and go/no-go launch decisions.
  • You are highly capable of managing external partners and vendors hands-on, including SLAs, escalations, invoices and contract follow-ups.
  • You understand how a trade flows from order to execution, settlement and custody, and what corporate actions and reconciliation involve. 
  • You are strong with data and spreadsheets, check numbers yourself, and like to document and improve processes.
  • You have experience working in a regulated environment, understanding when and how to secure Compliance and Legal sign-offs, and you possess excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
